THE_ANOMALY_IS_RESOLVED_AND_NEITHER_DECL.what_the_C2_job_declared: two branches -- SAMPLING NOISE (heavy-tailed rows, a property of the draw) or SPLIT-ERROR. It emitted 'NOT SAMPLING -- C is stably low; the SPLIT-ERROR branch is live'.
THE_ANOMALY_IS_RESOLVED_AND_NEITHER_DECL.what_it_actually_was: neither. Its composition prediction C_pred = A + w(B-A) used ONE train-region draw as B, and that draw is a +1.40 sd outlier of its own pool.

rebuild_with_the_pool_mean_instead_of_th.the_C2_job_called_it_6_9_percent_below_p: against the POOL it is +3.57 percent and -2.19 percent
rebuild_with_the_pool_mean_instead_of_th.READ: the shortfall dissolves. Both published C draws land within 0.4 sd of the rebuilt prediction, at the 62.5th and 39.0th percentile of 200 matched draws.

and_the_composition_MODEL_itself_is_vali.note: w = take/n2, the TRAIN FRACTION -- the same 0.799949 the C2 job used
and_the_composition_MODEL_itself_is_vali.READ: the composition model was right the whole time; one of its two operands was a bad estimate of a pool mean. That is why a two-point interpolation could not find it: the error was IN an endpoint, and an interpolation between two endpoints cannot see an endpoint's own sampling error. No mixing weight reaches it.

MY_PREDECLARED_POWER_GATE_IS_ONE_DIRECTI.the_emitted_verdict_preserved_verbatim: NO VERDICT BY THE PRE-FLIGHT CHECK -- leverage 1.58 < 2.0. The separation this test had to resolve (3.336672e-03) is smaller than 2.0x the row-set sd (2.114879e-03), so it cannot separate 'sampling' from 'not sampling'. Reported as no-power, not as a null result, and not reduced to a direction.
MY_PREDECLARED_POWER_GATE_IS_ONE_DIRECTI.THE_DEFECT_IS_MINE_AND_IT_IS_IN_THE_PRED: I wrote the gate as symmetric -- 'if the separation cannot resolve the residual, the test cannot separate sampling from not-sampling'. It is not symmetric. A SMALL gap-to-spread ratio is itself evidence FOR consistency with the draw; what low leverage forbids is the NOT-SAMPLING conclusion, which needs the gap to be large relative to the spread. So leverage 1.58 correctly blocks 'not sampling' and wrongly blocks 'consistent with sampling' along with it. A one-directional filter written as a two-directional one -- the same mode as a guard tested only for firing on bad input and never for silence on good.
MY_PREDECLARED_POWER_GATE_IS_ONE_DIRECTI.WHAT_I_AM_AND_AM_NOT_DOING_ABOUT_IT: The emitted label stands unchanged above. I am NOT re-fitting the gate to admit the answer I now prefer; that is the move predeclaration exists to prevent. What discharges the question instead is the composition rebuild in the previous section, which does not depend on the gate at all: it is a POSITIVE account of the mechanism with its own operands, not a failure to reject a null.

the_measurements_the_gate_blocked_report.standing: MEASUREMENTS, not a verdict. The verdict field above says NO VERDICT and keeps saying it.

THE_VALIDATION_POOL_SD_IS_NOT_A_SPREAD.why_it_is_not: the validation pool holds 800204 positions and each draw takes 799744 of them -- 0.9994 of the pool, omitting 460. Every 'draw' is essentially the SAME SET, and the sd measures that, not the row-to-row heterogeneity of the loss.
THE_VALIDATION_POOL_SD_IS_NOT_A_SPREAD.what_it_DOES_license: dL(A) is near-deterministic under a re-draw, because there is effectively only one validation row set. r5_sweep.py's primary number would not move if the validation slice were re-drawn -- a real and useful fact, reached for a completely different reason than 'the loss is stable on held-out rows'.
THE_VALIDATION_POOL_SD_IS_NOT_A_SPREAD.the_ratio_I_nearly_reported: 2.4e-3 / 1.987e-05 = 120.8x 'margin'. Arithmetically correct and it would have been a serious misstatement, because its denominator is not a spread. Naming the denominator is what caught it.

the_pools_where_the_sd_IS_a_spread.note: 0.25 and 0.20 -- genuine subset draws, so 2.393e-03 and 2.115e-03 are real spreads

WHAT_THE_R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CHECK_ACTU.the_check: max|dL(X) - dL(A)| over X in {B_train_region, C_independent_perm} against the 2.4e-3 CONFIRM bar, per member, r5_sweep.py:194-199
WHAT_THE_R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CHECK_ACTU.THE_THREE_ROW_SETS_ARE_THREE_DIFFERENT_P: A is ~the entire validation set (0.9994 of it). B is a 0.25 subset of the TRAIN region. C is a 0.20 subset of ALL positions, an 80/20 train-validation MIXTURE. A difference between them is dominated by COMPOSITION, not by row-set sampling. Measured pool means: validation 2.659578e-02, train 2.306519e-02, uniform 2.368517e-02 -- a 3.5e-3 spread ACROSS populations against a 2.4e-3 bar.
WHAT_THE_R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CHECK_ACTU.consequence_for_all_six_cells: every dL_rowset_max_dev in the R5 receipt is a cross-population difference. That holds for the four cells reading ROW-SET IMMATERIAL and the two reading THRESHOLD-INDETERMINATE alike -- the two alarming cells are alarming about composition.

genuine_rowset_sampling_noise_measured_h.READ: 1.00x to 1.13x. On a genuinely re-drawn subset the 2.4e-3 bar sits AT the row-set noise -- the concern I raised before this run, and it holds FOR SUBSET DRAWS. It does not reach dL(A), whose row set is not a subset draw.

WHAT_THE_R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CHECK_ACTU.the_C2_exceedance_and_the_branch_r5_decl: the C2 job's third row set deviates from A by 3.336672e-03 = 1.39x the bar. r5_sweep.py's predeclaration says that case is reported as threshold-indeterminate rather than picking a row set. The R5 receipt still carries ROW-SET IMMATERIAL for replica_29 and the string 'threshold-indeterminate' occurs nowhere in it. Both readings are superseded here FOR THIS MEMBER ONLY, and by neither label: the right statement is that the comparison was across populations.

R5_ROWSET_ROBUSTNESS_CONSEQUENCE.the_literal_quantifier_defence_and_why_i: r5's rule quantified over X in {B, C1} exactly, and C2 is not a member of that set, so the rule as WRITTEN was satisfied. That defence is thin: the rule's purpose is row-set robustness, and C2 is the same construction as C1 with a different seed -- i.e. precisely the evidence the rule exists to catch. Letting the quantifier's literal membership decide is measurability choosing the specification.
